evidence_items.publisher: University of Wisconsin, Madison, study record on ClinicalTrials.gov
evidence_items.explanation: The sponsor's official registry record confirms that the intervention used LLMs to generate clinical documentation and records actual completion on March 27, 2025. This supports the technology classification and timing of e1.

A separate Kenyan trial of LLM-assisted clinical decision support did not significantly reduce treatment failure. This limits any general claim of clinical effectiveness, but does not negate the demonstrated documentation application.

unresolved_gaps: The cited documentation benefit does not establish industry-wide profitability or improved patient outcomes.
